description: In the prestigious 1st arrondissement of Paris, a few steps from the Louvre, this 90 sqm air-conditioned apartment is ideal for your stay.→ Living room with open kitchen, TV with Netflix and sofa→ Autonomous check-in for maximum flexibility→ 2 suites with Queen-size beds, Smart TV and dressing room→ 1 bedroom with two single beds→ 2 bathrooms with walk-in shower and WC→ Fiber-optic Wifi at 1400+ Mbps for a fast, secure connection.→ Washer/dryer and dishwasherThe spaceWelcome to Cheval Blanc, a high-end apartment ideally located on the prestigious Rue du Pont Neuf, in the very heart of Paris. Just steps away from the Louvre, the Seine River, and luxury shopping, this exceptional location allows you to experience Paris entirely on foot.🛏 Accommodates up to 6 guestsThe apartment features 2 Queen-size beds and 2 single beds, offering high-quality bedding perfectly suited for families and groups of friends.❄️ Integrated air conditioningEnjoy optimal comfort throughout the year, whatever the season.🚿 Two elegant bathroomsEach bathroom is equipped with a walk-in shower and toilet, in a refined and contemporary setting.📺 Relaxation & entertainment areaSmart TV with Netflix, along with a large library for quiet evenings after a day exploring the city.📶 Ultra-fast Wi-FiA stable and high-speed connection, ideal for remote work or streaming.🍽 Modern, fully equipped kitchenIncludes a refrigerator, freezer, dishwasher, oven, microwave, kettle, toaster, and a Nespresso coffee machine—everything you need to cook comfortably at home.👕 Practical amenities for a worry-free stayWashing machine, dryer, and iron are available for your convenience.🧺 Linen & essentials providedBed linen and towels, pillows, hair dryer, cleaning products, as well as a welcome kit including shower gel and shampo
